newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Ahold reports 18.3 pct rise in Q2 net.
newsitem.headline: Ahold reports 18.3 pct rise in Q2 net.

text.p: Dutch supermarkets group Ahold NV said on Thursday second quarter 1996 net profit rose 18.3 percent to 121.3 million guilders ($73.1 million) from 102.5 million.
Ahold, which generates half of its sales in the United States, said second quarter revenues rose to 7.83 billion guilders from 6.76 billion.
The group reiterated its earlier forecast that earnings for the whole of 1996 would be higher than in 1995.
Ahold said the recently acquired U.S. chain Stop & Shop would contribute to the rise in profits.
"Further growth of profits per share is expected to be positively affected by this takeover," it said.
Second quarter earnings were at the high end of analysts' forecasts which ranged from 111 million to 123 million guilders.
On the Amsterdam bourse Ahold shares rose 0.80 guilders to 93.80, having previously traded at unchanged levels before the results were published. ($ = 1.660 Dutch Guilders)
